Start.description: A ticket, and the sink the caller has already served on a channel of this connection.

Started.description: The job the worker has served on a channel of this connection, for the caller to resolve.

Sunk.description: A reference inside a sum. The variant would be duplex.Handle itself but for #210, which refuses to render a carried built-in as a union variant; a record around it carries the reference just as transitively.

Either.description: A reference or a value, in the same sum.

Held.description: Every position the language admits a reference in, in one message.

Forward.description: A sink this worker is to re-export into the connection it holds to another worker.

start.description: Take a sink, answer with a job.

collect.description: Resolve every reference in the message and say how many were resolved and how many refused.

forward.description: Re-export the sink into another connection's scope and have the worker there report through it.

slow.description: A call that does not answer until its own cancellation, so that cancelling it can be told from releasing a reference.

errors.unknown_reference: The reference names no channel of this connection, or one that speaks another family.
errors.no_origin: This worker holds no connection to forward into.
